flags.issueFull: FD49-3 results (v3.9, Brain 8 mirrors, sim-only, 1,000 each): 7v7 equal Command with Arrow Storm ×1.5 gives the first mover 64.6% of decisive games, outside F12. Inside 45–55%: equal Command (10 and 10) with Arrow Storm ×2 (49.8%, turn limit 12.4%) and first turn 6 with ×1.5 (49.4%, 14.6%). 5v5 at Command 8: none in range (best ×1.5, 56.5%, with Arrow Storm almost never killing). FD49-4 holds for Brain 8: at ×1.5 first turn 5 and 8 play identical games
flags.next: Recommended for 7v7: equal full Command from turn 1 with Arrow Storm kept at ×2 (the smaller rule change, in range, fewest stalls). 5v5 stays open until a brain spends first-turn Command (FD49-4). A rules brief would make it a new preset

flags.issueFull: New evidence on the default opponent (F022-5). Re-measured on v3.9 at the shipped settings (1,000 games each), Brain 8 against Brain 5: balanced 5v5 467 won, 454 lost (even); all-Light 5v5 457, 519; balanced 7v7 455, 530; all-Light 7v7 465, 519. It wins more by KO or TKO but loses 2 to 3 tiebreaks for every one it wins. On v3.8 at tempo 0 and 0 it was even. Not isolated: v3.9 and tempoSecond +1 changed together
flags.next: Recommended: keep Brain 8 as the default (it finishes games, which a human opponent notices more than tiebreak margins) and have the next brain brief isolate the tiebreak losses (tempoSecond 0 against +1 on v3.9, 1,000 games). If the Editor wants the strongest default instead, revert to Brain 5: one line in app.js
